title: Second, Second, First
title_candidates: Mullin Broke the Course, Baker Broke the Record
theme: A tournament of broken records in which the biggest one came last: Mullin rewrote Boavista on day one, but Alex Baker — twice a runner-up, three times bottom of the Jacket, once a Spoon-holder — improved in every single round (41-45-47-51) until the Trophy was simply his.
tone: house — faithful, tongue-in-cheek, Ronay/Peck: affectionate ribbing of insiders, every number checkable
opening_hook: Open on Alex Baker's ledger as he arrived in Lagos — second in TEG 8, second in TEG 9, last in the Jacket three TEGs running, a Wooden Spoon already on the shelf — then Act 1 rewinds to R1 at Boavista, where somebody else was busy breaking everything.
foreshadow: Alex Baker's arrival ledger: runner-up in TEG 8 and TEG 9, 6th in the Jacket in each of the last three TEGs, one prior Wooden Spoon — the perennial nearly-man
David Mullin's R1 75 at Boavista (cr01/b05) looked like a tournament-ender: a course record on his 11th visit and the best gross round in TEG history
John Patterson arrived as the defending Trophy champion (TEG 9) — and was last in the field by the 4th hole of R1
The closing hole and the par-5 8th as the tournament's recurring wrecking yard: 10s, 9s and an 11 collected there across all four rounds

competitions.name: Trophy (Stableford)
competitions.how: Baker sat 8 back after R1 and 5 back after R2, then took the lead outright with a par at the SI 11 6th in R3 (b01/b14), ending Mullin's 30-hole reign. Williams grabbed it back at R3 H13 (b19) — the very hole where Baker made 10 (b26) — and drew level again at R4 H5 (b30), but Baker's 21 points in six holes (b04) and a record 51-point round (b06) turned it into an 11-point win on 184 pts (b02). Baker's round scores went 41, 45, 47, 51: better every single day.

competitions.name: Green Jacket (Gross)
competitions.how: Effectively over by teatime on day one: Mullin's 75 (+4) at Boavista was a new course record on his 11th visit there (cr01) and the best gross round in TEG history (b05), opening a 14-shot cushion. He led after every round, the only two Jacket lead changes came inside R1, and he closed at +51 to win by 12 from Jon Baker (b03) — an eighth Jacket, and a third in a row.

competitions.name: Wooden Spoon
competitions.how: The defending Trophy champion dropped to the bottom of the field at R1 H4 and never climbed out of it for the remaining 68 holes. Tens at the par-5 8th in R1 (b33) and R3 (b34), a 10 at the very first hole of R2 (b24), 19 shots bled across holes 11-15 in R3 (b29), then an 11 at the 8th (b25) inside a 21-point closing round (b40) — his worst to date — left him on 112 pts (b28).

rounds.chosen_headline: Mullin Rewrites Boavista at the Eleventh Attempt
rounds.angle: Mullin's 75 (+4) is a new Boavista course record and the best gross round in TEG history; his 49 pts is the second-best round ever and hands him an 8-point cushion — while the closing hole devours Neumann and Williams and Patterson slides to the bottom at the 4th.

headline_candidates: New Ground, New Personal Bests — and a 10 at the First
Palmares Hands Out Prizes to Almost Everybody
rounds.chosen_headline: New Ground, New Personal Bests — and a 10 at the First
rounds.angle: On a Palmares combination nobody in TEG had ever played, Williams (48 pts, +14), Alex Baker (45 pts, +23) and Jon Baker (+10 gross, third-best gross round in TEG history) all posted career numbers; Mullin's lead shrank to five, Patterson signed for a 10 at the opening hole, and Neumann re-enacted his 18th.

headline_candidates: Thirty Holes in Front, Undone by a Par
The Lead Changes Hands on the 11th-Hardest Hole
Baker Makes 10 and Still Sets a Personal Best
rounds.chosen_headline: Thirty Holes in Front, Undone by a Par
rounds.angle: Mullin's reign — unbroken since R1 H12 — ends with an unremarkable Baker par at the SI 11 6th (b01/b14); Williams snatches the lead outright at the 13th (b19), the same hole where Baker made 10 (b26), and Baker still walks off with a personal-best 47 pts and +22.

headline_candidates: Fifty-One: The Best Round Ever Played in TEG
Williams Draws Level, Baker Draws Away
Baker Settles the Ledger at Boavista
rounds.chosen_headline: Fifty-One: The Best Round Ever Played in TEG
rounds.angle: Williams levelled with a birdie at the 5th and was never that close again: Baker answered with 21 points in six holes and a TEG-record 51-point round (+17, another personal best) to win by 11, while Mullin's +13 sealed an eighth Jacket and Patterson's 11 at the 8th closed out the Spoon.

players.arc: Arrived with two runner-up finishes, three straight last-place Jacket finishes and a Spoon on his record; improved in every round (41-45-47-51), took the lead with a par at R3 H6, survived a 10 at the 13th, and finished with the best round in TEG history and a first Trophy by 11.
Broke the Boavista course record and the TEG gross-round record inside four hours of R1, led the Trophy for 30 holes, then handed it over on a par — consoled by an eighth Green Jacket, won by 12.

Three-time Trophy winner who set personal bests at Palmares (48 pts, +14) and a new Boavista best of 93, led outright at R3 H13 and drew level at R4 H5, but a 7 at the 6th and an 8 at the last left him second by 11.

Posted the third-best gross round in TEG history (+10 at Palmares), a Boavista personal best of 86 and a personal-best gross total of +63 — and was still Jacket runner-up, now four times in five TEGs without a win.

Defending Trophy champion who was last in the field from R1 H4 to the final putt, collecting a 10 at the 1st, tens at the 8th twice, an 11 at the 8th and a 21-point closing round on the way to 112 pts and the Spoon.
Reigning double-Spoon holder who escaped the Spoon this time purely by out-pointing Patterson, while donating sextuple-bogey 10s at the 18th in consecutive rounds and a third 10 at Palmares' 13th.

venue_notes: TEG's 4th visit to the Algarve, based in Lagos. Boavista bookends the tournament — the 11th and 12th TEG rounds there, and by now a course the regulars know hole by hole, which is exactly why Mullin's 75 (prior best across 50 visits: 82) matters. The middle two days are brand-new ground: two different combinations of Robert Trent Jones Jr's 27 holes at Palmares, the seaside Praia links spliced onto parkland Alvor in R2, then the pure-parkland Alvor/Lagos in R3. Note the Atlantic views at Boavista and its two distinct halves; note that a course nobody had seen handed out five personal bests in R2. Keep the closing hole as running scenery.
course_history_notes: Mullin's 11th visit to Boavista produced a new personal best there — 75 gross, beating his 82 from TEG 5 by seven, and 23 shots better than his last visit
Jon Baker's new Boavista personal best in R4: 86 gross, four better than his 90 from TEG 3 and nine better than his last visit
Williams's new Boavista personal best in R4: 93 gross, beating his 97 from TEG 3 and ten better than his last visit
Neumann, also on his 11th visit to Boavista, matched his last visit exactly and remains 16 shots off his own 82 there from TEG 5; Alex Baker and Patterson were seeing Boavista for the first time
decisive_moments: Trophy — R3 H6 at Palmares Alvor/Lagos: Alex Baker's par ends Mullin's 30-hole lead (b01/b14); the last real threat, Williams level at R4 H5 (b30), was buried by Baker's 21 points in six holes (b04) and a record 51-point round (b06).
Green Jacket — R1 at Boavista: Mullin's 75 (+4) course record (cr01/b05) opened a 14-shot cushion; there was not a single Jacket lead change after R1 and he won by 12 (b03).

Wooden Spoon — R1 H4: Patterson dropped to the bottom of the field and stayed there for all 68 remaining holes; the 19 shots bled over R3 holes 11-15 (b29) and the 21-point R4 (b40) made it arithmetic (b28).

payoffs.seed: Alex Baker's nearly-man ledger (2nd, 2nd, three straight 6ths in the Jacket, one Spoon)
payoffs.resolves_in: Round 4 and How the three were decided
payoffs.payoff: 184 pts, a first Trophy by 11, the best round in TEG history (b06) and a personal-best gross total of +90 (b20) — the ledger closed in one afternoon at Boavista.

payoffs.seed: Mullin's R1 75 looked like a tournament-ender
payoffs.resolves_in: Round 3 and the Green Jacket section
payoffs.payoff: It won him the Jacket by 12 (b03) and nothing else: the record round bought him 30 holes of Trophy lead before Baker's ordinary par at R3 H6 took it away (b01).
Bottom of the field from R1 H4 to the last green, 112 pts and the Spoon (b28) — champion to Spoon in a single TEG.

payoffs.seed: The closing hole and the par-5 8th as the tournament's wrecking yard
payoffs.payoff: Neumann's 10s at the 18th in R1 and R2 (b31/b32), Williams's 9 there in R1 and 8 in R4, Mullin's 8 at the 18th in R3 (b39), Patterson's 9 at the last in R4 (b36) — plus his tens at the 8th in R1 and R3 and an 11 there in R4 (b33/b34/b25), and Alex Baker's own 9 at the 8th in R1.

vehicle_fit_response.note: Taken up — Alex Baker's first Trophy after two runner-up finishes and a Spoon is plainly the story; inversion (defending champion to Spoon, Mullin's 30-hole lead lost) and the 18th/8th motif ride alongside as supporting frames.
